thread:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads up — offer for Lila W. (req LW-147) needs a comp-band uplift + earlier start date. Candidate signed; wants to start 2025-04-01; current offer uses Band IC3. Requesting IC4-equivalent uplift for scope. Details below.

Marta (Talent Acquisition): Can you drop the comp summary and reason? I'll route.

Priya (People Ops): Sure — current package:
```
Base: $165,000 (IC3 midpoint)
Sign-on: $10,000 one-time
Equity: 0.4% (4-year)
Requested: +10% base (to match IC4), keep equity
Reason: Candidate is lead on cross-team infra project, manager says role scope > IC3
Start date: 2025-04-01 (candidate already gave notice)
Cost center: Eng Platform (US-East payroll)
```

Ezra (Hiring Manager): Confirming — this is not a title change, it's scope bump but we need comp to match market. Project go-live in mid-April, can't delay start.

Payroll Ops: If we expedite approval, payroll cutoff for Apr 1 is Mar 25. If offer changes base, we need compensation paperwork in by Mar 22 to hit first payroll. Also need to confirm relocation taxable gross-up? Candidate is remote, no relocation.

Priya (People Ops): Noted. We'll need comp committee sign-off. Marta can you route to Raj + Sofia for expedited review? Also need ethics signoff? not sure.

Marta (Talent Acquisition): On it. @Raj @Sofia — can you review matrix + approve uplift? If approved, I'll update offer and send revised LOI. ETA 24–48h please.

Raj (Comp Lead): I'm tied up today but can review tonight. Quick Q: do you want permanent uplifts or one-time market adjustment? propose permanent if scope is permanent.

Sofia (Finance): Need budget code and monthly run rate impact. Priya pls DM the cost center code. If permanent +10% base, comp burden needs FY review but we can approve with retro budget annotation.

HR Bot: Automated reminder — approvals pending: Comp Committee (Raj), Finance (Sofia). Ticket #PO-8792. SLA target 48h.

Priya (People Ops): Budget code ENG-PLAT-3, candidate is US-remote (MA). No relocation. If Raj/Sofia approve, please mark 'expedite' so Marta can change start to 2025-04-01 and send signed LOI before Mar 22.

Marta (Talent Acquisition): Copy. I'll prepare revised LOI draft once I see 'approved' from comp/finance.

Raj (Comp Lead): Approve permanent +10% base. +:thumbsup: Please update job profile and stack.

Sofia (Finance): Finance approves contingent on cost-center annotation. Marked in PO system. :white_check_mark:

Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — routing done. Marta pls proceed with revised LOI. Payroll Ops, please flag for Mar 22 cutoff.

Payroll Ops: Flagged. I will run checklist and confirm before EOD Mar 22.
